think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and units and whether it has a normal numeric ordering. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special numeric values (commonly 0 or -1) that change the knob’s meaning (e.g., disable a feature or switch to a different mode) rather than just scaling it. 3) Determine if setting the knob to that value results in qualitatively different behavior (on/off/auto) versus merely ‘smaller/larger’. 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
